g.text: Long-channel enhancement nMOS teaching model, V_DS≥0, body tied to source, λ=0. K here includes the conventional one-half factor in saturation: I_D=K V_OV², so
g_m=2K V_OV. Cutoff is V_GS≤V_th. Boundary locus is schematic model region separation, not a device rating; subthreshold conduction, body effect and velocity
